answer: Each identity tends a tundra plume gauge, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it releases a plume; drift is filed with a fresh serial. The prism table maps wind and temperature to expected drift. A drift off by over 3%, or a reused serial, burns the bond. The first gauge costs 36, the kth 36+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500, vs 40,000 rewards. A rented-gauge ring fails: one gauge cannot serve two tundra plumes. An honest agent pays 36 once.
